caption: The drawing consists of three main elements arranged on a plain, off-white or beige background. In the upper center is a detailed depiction of a decorative, V-shaped object composed of repeating circular and oval patterns, suggesting the appearance of beads or gems, with leaf-like shapes featured symmetrically in the center. Below that, in the middle of the page, there is a similar V-shaped design, distinguished by a thicker arrangement of overlapping circular segments and featuring elongated triangular elements and a central oval shape, creating a more geometric pattern. To the right of both designs, there is a single, vertical side view illustration of a thin, slightly curved object with a series of small circles along its edge, likely representing a side profile of the decorative items. The line work throughout the drawing is done in thin, precise gray or black pencil or ink lines, and there is no added color or shading. In the bottom right corner, there is a handwritten signature, "J.A. Holloway." In the bottom left corner, faintly printed, are the words “MOULDED WHITE METAL.”
title: Steel Buckle
